register.title: Joost de Winter's packing of 172 squares at JoostdeWinter/square-packing c4e65d0, issue 946
register.headline: De Winter's re-solve of T-282's packing at 172, at its padding; held
register.source_checks:
The issue says verify_exact.py, Python's standard library with fractions.Fraction, checks exact unit edge directions, containment, a separating-axis test on every pair of squares with centres closer than sqrt(2), and by an exact sign test that the side lies within 1e-318 above the real root near 13.6147 of 62x^5 - 4116x^4 + 107933x^3 - 1397031x^2 + 8918035x - 22427977; that it is the one checker, written for this certificate, and was not run against this repository's checkers.

The issue says the side is 1.6e-319 above that root, the exact local optimum of the arrangement: a solution of the contact equations at about 390 digits closes all contacts with a residual below 1e-389, the equations have rank 285 and fix the side to first order, non-negative contact forces in balance exist (floating point), and the polynomial, identified from 108 digits of an earlier 130-digit solution, agrees with the 390-digit side to 386 digits; local optimality has no formal proof. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit:
Credit Joost de Winter, who reports the exact local optimum of the n = 172 arrangement of issue 935 (T-282: Evan Daniel's packing, T-257, improved by Doğa Özden), with no square added, removed or moved to another place in the contact structure, and asks to be credited as its improver; the issue credits the arrangement to Daniel and Özden. It is the 172-square core of his issue 939 at 199.

The issue says the local optimization, high-precision solution, rational certificate, checking and figure were produced with Claude Fable 5.2 (Anthropic) under his direction.
register.next_rung: Hold below the stage 4 exit, at V0/C0 as T-280 and T-285 are, for the owner's RV-3 (think-ruu2): the gain over T-282 is 1.04 times T-282's own uniform-contraction margin, and the packing is the KKT point of Evan Daniel's held solve below T-282 (think-wju3). If the answer keeps it, review it at stage 4 and adopt it at 172 in place of T-282 under the house rule, with both strong generators' regularization and the flip of the new house.
